map.基于Bhutani小时胆红素百分位曲线，评估新生儿高胆红素血症风险分区及光疗/换: Bhutani hour-specific bilirubin percentile curve: assess neonatal hyperbilirubinemia risk zones and phototherapy/exchange thresholds
map.提示：高危因素包括同族免疫性溶血、G6PD缺乏症、败血症、头皮血肿、纯母乳喂养性: Note: high-risk factors include isoimmune hemolysis, G6PD deficiency, sepsis, cephalohematoma, breast-milk jaundice etc. Smaller gestation/weight -> lower phototherapy threshold. Kernicterus warning: lethargy, hypotonia, weak suck, high-pitched cry, opisthotonos. This tool is for clinical reference only.
map.TSB 超过换血阈值(随小时/胎龄)或上升过快，警惕胆红素脑病。: TSB exceeds exchange threshold (by hour/GA) or rises too fast; watch for kernicterus.
map.关于「新生儿黄疸(小时胆红素)曲线器」: About the Newborn Jaundice (Hour-Specific Bilirubin) Curve Tool
map.新生儿黄疸小时胆红素(Bhutani)曲线评估器，根据出生小时数和血清胆红素值判: The newborn hour-specific bilirubin (Bhutani) curve assessor uses hours of life and serum bilirubin to assign risk zones and guide phototherapy/exchange. A medical professional tool based on authoritative standards, for reference only.
map.新生儿黄疸按 Bhutani 曲线：血清总胆红素(TSB, mg/dL) 结合出: Neonatal jaundice by the Bhutani curve: serum total bilirubin (TSB, mg/dL) is compared with the 25th/40th/75th/95th percentiles and phototherapy/exchange thresholds by postnatal hours, gestational age and risk factors. Risk zones: >=p95 high risk, >=p75 intermediate-high, >=p40 intermediate-low, <p40 low risk; TSB >= phototherapy threshold starts phototherapy, >= exchange threshold requires urgent exchange transfusion.
map.表中为≥38 周、无神经毒性风险因素足月儿的阈值（与本工具计算口径一致）。35–: The table gives thresholds for term infants >=38 weeks without neurotoxicity risk factors (consistent with this tool's calculation). At 35-37 weeks or with risk factors such as hemolysis/G6PD/sepsis, lower the threshold by about 2 mg/dL (intermediate risk); at <35 weeks lower by about 4-5 mg/dL (high risk).
map.48 小时 TSB 10 mg/dL、胎龄 38 周：位于 p40–p75 之间: 48h TSB 10 mg/dL at 38 weeks: between p40 and p75 (low-intermediate risk zone); low-risk term phototherapy threshold at 48-72h is 18 mg/dL, so 10<18 needs no phototherapy; monitor closely.
map.48h 同值 14：中危（≥38 周伴危险因素或 35–37 周无危险因素）阈值: At 48h with TSB 14: intermediate-risk threshold (>=38 weeks with risk factors, or 35-37 weeks without) is 15, not reached; high-risk threshold (35-37 weeks with risk factors) is 13, exceeded so phototherapy is indicated; for <35 weeks use the 2022 AAP preterm curve.
map.💡 光疗与换血指征 (AAP 2004 近似值，已被 AAP 2022 取代): 💡 Phototherapy and exchange indications (AAP 2004 approximations, superseded by AAP 2022)
map.表中为≥38 周、无神经毒性风险因素足月儿的 AAP 2004 小时胆红素曲线近: Table values are approximate AAP 2004 hour-specific bilirubin thresholds for infants ≥38 weeks without neurotoxicity risk factors (same basis as this tool). AAP 2022 (Kemper et al., Pediatrics 2022;150(3):e2022060643) supersedes AAP 2004; use the 2022 hour-specific threshold charts clinically. For 35–37 weeks or risk factors such as hemolysis/G6PD/sepsis, lower by about 2 mg/dL (intermediate risk); for <35 weeks lower by about 4–5 mg/dL (high risk).
map.48 小时 TSB 14 mg/dL、胎龄 38 周：Bhutani ≥95 百: 48 h TSB 14 mg/dL at 38 weeks: Bhutani ≥95th percentile (P95≈12), high-risk zone. This page's AAP 2004 low-risk phototherapy threshold is 18; 14<18 means no phototherapy now, but close follow-up and recheck against AAP 2022 thresholds are required.
map.同值若 35–37 周且无危险因素（本页中危 48–72 h 阈值 15），14: For the same value at 35–37 weeks without risk factors (intermediate risk, 48–72 h threshold 15 here), 14<15 does not reach phototherapy; with risk factors (high-risk threshold 13), 14≥13 requires phototherapy. For <35 weeks, recheck against the 2022 AAP preterm curves.
map.光疗/换血阈值为 AAP 2004 小时胆红素曲线近似值（AAP 2022 已取: Phototherapy/exchange thresholds are approximations from the AAP 2004 hour-specific bilirubin curves (AAP 2022 supersedes 2004; use 2022 clinically) and require clinical review. For <35 weeks, assess separately with the 2022 AAP/NICHD preterm curves.
